comments.content: [medium] Using a space character as the default for the deprecated `systemPrompt` field is unclear and could lead to confusion — an empty string would be clearer, or at least add a comment explaining why the space is required.

[medium] There is a possible NPE here: getBrowserDebug() returns the wrapper type Boolean, which can be null when the configuration is unset, and auto-unboxing to a primitive boolean would then throw a NullPointerException. Safer to use Boolean.TRUE.equals() or supply a default value (e.g., Boolean.TRUE.equals(getBrowserUseTool().getManusProperties().getBrowserDebug())).
[low] The intent of `MoveToAndClickAction` is not obvious from this location; a concise explanation would help maintainers.
[low] Please clarify whether `fill("")` is expected to be case-sensitive at this boundary.
